serverless.title: Serverless Architecture
serverless.desc: Building event-driven, cost-effective applications that scale infinitely without the overhead of server management.

overview_desc_1: Serverless is the logical evolution of cloud computing. It allows your business to pay only for the exact milliseconds of execution time, eliminating the cost of idle resources. We design event-driven architectures that react to data changes, user actions, and system signals in real-time.
overview_desc_2: Our serverless solutions leverage AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, and Google Cloud Functions to build highly decoupled applications. This approach minimizes the surface area of maintenance and maximizes the velocity of feature delivery.

overview_cards.title: Zero Server Management
overview_cards.desc: Focus entirely on business logic while the cloud provider handles the underlying infrastructure.

overview_cards.title: Infinite Scalability
overview_cards.desc: Automatically scale from zero to millions of requests without manual intervention.

overview_cards.title: Granular Cost Model
overview_cards.desc: Pay-per-execution billing ensures 100% resource utilization efficiency.

envs.title: Triggering
envs.desc: Capturing events from API calls, S3 uploads, or database stream changes.

envs.title: Execution
envs.desc: Rapid cold-start and execution of logic in isolated, ephemeral runtimes.

envs.title: Settlement
envs.desc: Persisting state and returning responses before immediate resource teardown.

reliability.title: Built-in High Availability
reliability.desc: Serverless platforms are inherently multi-AZ and fail-fast, providing a resilient environment for modern web and mobile backends.

layers.title: Function Identity
layers.desc: Per-function IAM roles to enforce the principle of least privilege.

layers.title: VPC Integration
layers.desc: Securing serverless functions within private subnets for DB access.

layers.title: Concurrent Limits
layers.desc: Preventing DDoS and cost-drain through execution throttling.

layers.title: Event Validation
layers.desc: Strict schema validation at the gateway level to prevent injection.

cards.title: Cold Start Warmer
cards.desc: Strategies to keep functions 'warm' for latency-sensitive applications.

cards.title: Asynchronous Processing
cards.desc: Utilizing SQS and EventBridge to offload heavy long-running tasks.

cards.title: Global Distribution
cards.desc: Deploying logic at the edge (Lambda@Edge) for extreme global performance.

operations.title: Observing the Invisible
operations.desc: Monitoring distributed execution through specialized serverless telemetry.

cards.title: Automatic Retries
cards.desc: Native platform capability to retry failed executions up to 3 times.

cards.title: Redundancy-by-Default
cards.desc: Functions are automatically replicated across all regional availability zones.

cards.title: Global Fallback
cards.desc: Rerouting events to alternate regions during total regional failure.

cost.title: Pay-as-you-Scale
cost.desc: Eliminating the cost of idle servers. You pay nothing when no one is using your application.

migration.title: Refactoring for Serverless
migration.desc: Moving from monoliths to micro-functions requires a change in mindset.
